settings.Absturzspur.desc: Records which of the mod's systems is running on EVERY frame and forces it straight to disk, so after a crash the trace says where it happened. Costs noticeable performance. Only turn it on if you can reproduce a crash. Turns itself off the next time you start the game.
settings.Absturzspur.label: Record a crash trace (may become laggy after time, only use when needed)
settings.Auto.desc: Switches to entrance mode right after the polygon is closed. Off: the polygon stays editable first and you switch over yourself when you are ready.
settings.Auto.label: Switch to entrance mode automatically
settings.AutomatischSynchronisieren.desc: New versions of the mod sometimes need to update existing parking lots. With this on, that happens after loading, spread over several frames, with a small progress note at the bottom. Off: a note in the parking lot window leads to the list, where you update one lot or all. Shape and settings of the lots stay as they are.
settings.Entfernen.desc: Demolishes the parking lots this mod built in the loaded city. Meant for the step BEFORE uninstalling: afterwards the mod can no longer clean anything up, and a save written without it loses its parking lot data for good. Grown zoning buildings stay — those are yours, not the mod's; their road and utility connections may go with the teardown, though. Wait until the button says “Done”, then save. Greyed out in the main menu, where there is no city.
settings.Entfernen.knopf.fertigMitResten: Done: {weg} removed, {stehen} remained — see the log
settings.Entfernen.warning: Demolish every parking lot this mod built in this city? The tool's undo cannot take this back — back up your save first.
settings.Entwickler.desc:
Shows the "Dev-Debug" tab in the panel. It holds measuring tools from development: zoning probe, prefab dissection, carrier test, overlap scan, prefab comparison and the live log.

You do not need this to report a problem - the always-visible "Report a problem" tab is for that. Some of these tools build and delete things in your city.
settings.Entwickler.label: Show developer tab
settings.FensterZuruecksetzen.desc: Puts the parking lot window back to the top edge, horizontally centred. Use this if it was dragged off screen and can no longer be grabbed.
settings.FensterZuruecksetzen.label: Reset window position
settings.Fensterstil.desc: Horizontal is the wide bar with its columns side by side. Upright is the narrow column at the bottom left, where the game shows its own tool options - it covers the least. Both hold the same settings.
settings.Fensterstil.label: Panel layout
settings.Gebuehr.desc: Copied into each new parking lot when it is built. Existing lots are then adjusted individually in their selection panel. 0 means free; revenue appears under 'Parking'.
settings.Gebuehr.label: Default fee for new parking lots
settings.Loeschen.desc: Ask before bulldozing a PLT parking lot. Default: on. Takes effect immediately; confirmations for other buildings remain unchanged.
settings.Loeschen.label: Confirm parking lot demolition
settings.Sprache.desc: Applies to the parking lot window, its messages and this page. Automatic follows the game language if the mod has a translation for it, otherwise English.
settings.Sprache.label: Interface language
settings.Unterhalt.desc: How much the parking lots cost to maintain, compared to the game's own parking lots of the same size (100 %). Applies to all parking lots right away. The road services budget in the game scales it on top.
settings.Unterhalt.label: Upkeep costs
settings.Vegetation.desc:
How many plants per square metre are placed, relative to 1.0.

At 1.0 every plant keeps exactly the distance at which the game itself starts hiding overlapping plants - so everything placed is also visible. Above that it gets airier. Below it gets denser and the game hides some again; that is the price of a thicket.

The slider in the panel is unaffected: it says how much of the possible is planted. Existing lots keep their plants until they are rebuilt.
settings.Vegetation.label: Planting density
settings.Version.desc: The loaded version and when its DLL was written. Both belong in a bug report; the build time tells you whether the game is really running the newer build.
settings.Version.label: Version
settings.Versorgung.desc:
Lays a power line and a combined pipe to the parking lot while building. It always builds the shortest link between two parts that are not connected yet - several zoning patches far apart may hook up to each other. At least one line always reaches a city road, otherwise no power comes in.

It routes around our own roads and around existing buried lines; if CS2 rejects one route, another is tried.

Off: no new lines are created. Connections you laid yourself are still preserved when editing - that is a separate mechanism and does not depend on this switch.
settings.Versorgung.label: Connect power and water automatically
settings.WaisenAutomatischReparieren.des: If a save was stored without Parking Lot Tool, its parking lots lose their link to the mod: they are missing from the list and cannot be removed cleanly. With this on, the mod reconnects them after loading, one at a time. The same goes for lots with surfaces or plants from a mod that is no longer loaded: they get your saved default surface and plants. Off: the list and the info panel offer a button instead.
settings.WerkzeugTaste.desc: Default is Ctrl+Shift+P. It used to be Ctrl+P, but Find It uses that combination too and its tool won. Change the key here if it clashes with another mod.
settings.WerkzeugTaste.label: Open and close the tool
settings.Wirtschaft.desc: Master switch. ON means: upkeep scaled by size, parking fee, noise pollution, workers, and the comfort that makes the lot attractive to drivers. OFF means: the lot is purely a structure and costs nothing. You can toggle it at any time; it applies at once to every existing lot. Fees you have set are kept and come back when you switch it on again. Lots built while it was off get the default fee below when you switch it on. The lot never needs power.
settings.Wirtschaft.label: Simulate economy
settings.ZonBreite.desc:
How many parcels wide a zoning area may be at most. One parcel is 8 m. Default 25.

Note: zoning grows from the surrounding roads, and CS2 builds at most 6 parcels deep per road. Beyond roughly 12 parcels a strip in the middle stays empty - no road reaches it.
settings.ZonBreite.label: Zoning area: maximum width
settings.ZonTiefe.desc: How many parcels deep a zoning area may be at most. One parcel is 8 m. Default 25. The same note as for the width applies here.
settings.ZonTiefe.label: Zoning area: maximum depth
settings.Zuruecksetzen.desc:
Resets this page AND the defaults remembered in the panel back to how the mod ships. The language goes back to English.

Parking lots you already built are untouched - only the values the next one is built with are reset.
settings.Zuruecksetzen.label: Reset all settings

ui.befundNichts: Nothing was flagged during the last run.
ui.berichtOrt: The file goes to the game's Logs folder and is called 'ParkingLotTool-report-…txt'. It is short enough to send.
ui.debugLiveLogHinweis: Writes one short line per preview run while you work — what was calculated, and where the time went. Starts a fresh file every time you switch it on.
ui.debugPrefabvergleichHinweis: Writes the junction-relevant prefab data of the zoning road clone, its Alley original and the invisible paths to ParkingLotTool.Mod.log. No selection needed.
ui.debugSezieren: Prefab dump: how is a real parking lot built?
ui.debugSeziererHinweis: Writes a text file listing what the game’s own parking lot prefabs are made of — their parts, their ECS components, and what our own surface is missing compared to them. Changes nothing; you can press it any time. Place a vanilla parking lot first if you want the section about a finished one to be filled in.
ui.debugSonde: Probe run: what does CS2 accept?
ui.debugSondeHinweis: Places single test surfaces on the terrain, reads from the triangle buffer whether CS2 accepted them, deletes them again and halves its way to the real limit. Only ever one surface at a time. Point at a spot on the ground first, then start.
ui.debugTraeger: Carrier test: can a bare owner hold the markings?
ui.debugTraegerHinweis: An experiment, not a build step. It re-parents five markings of an existing lot to a bare carrier entity and watches whether they stay put. USE A THROWAWAY SAVE. Press “Start carrier test”, then hover the lot, build a road next to it, save, reload - and press “Finish carrier test”.
ui.debugUeberlappungHinweis: Select a PLT parking lot or a building grown on its zoning road, then scan. The result always goes to ParkingLotTool.Mod.log; an enabled live log receives the detailed trace as well.
ui.debugZoningsondeHinweis: Point at a free place on the ground, choose the narrow real road and build the probe. Its complete result is written to the game log with the prefix PLT-Zoningsonde:. Use a throwaway save.

ui.tooltipAutoZufahrt: After the outline is closed, switch to entrance placement right away. Same switch as in the mod settings.
ui.tooltipBauen: Builds what the preview shows · Enter
ui.tooltipBauplanWiederherstellen: Reads the plan back from the build log so the lot can be edited again. Nothing in the city changes.
ui.tooltipBearbeiten: Reopens this lot to change its outline, entrances and settings.
ui.tooltipBearbeitenListe: Jump to the lot and reopen it for editing.
ui.tooltipBerichtSchreiben: Writes your marks and what the mod last did into one file you can send.
ui.tooltipBuchtsymbole: Paints the lines and the disabled and electric symbols.
ui.tooltipBushaltestelle: Place a working bus stop on either side of a zoning road. The cursor chooses the side; right click removes a stop.
ui.tooltipDebug: Measuring runs for when something looks wrong.
ui.tooltipDebugLiveLog: For reporting a problem that only happens on your shape: switch it on, do the one thing, switch it off, send the file.
ui.tooltipDebugSezieren: Writes down what one of the game's own lots is made of.
ui.tooltipDebugSonde: Tries hundreds of shapes and notes which ones CS2 accepts.
ui.tooltipDebugTraeger: Checks whether the markings stay put without a building.
ui.tooltipDebugUeberlappung: Finds Overridden objects and exact collision pairs only around the selected lot.
ui.tooltipDebugZoningsonde: Builds one real road and logs its zoning and growth.
ui.tooltipEinfahrt: One way in. Needs an exit somewhere else.
ui.tooltipEntwurf: Outline, rows, roads and surfaces of the lot you are drawing.
ui.tooltipErgebnisGeschaetzt: Upkeep minus estimated fees. CS2 books no parking income per lot - this is the mod counting arrivals, and it counts low: a car that comes and goes between two samples is never seen.
ui.tooltipErgebnisKosten: Upkeep per month, the same figure the info window shows.
ui.tooltipFahrgassenbreite: Widens the aisles — more room to manoeuvre.
ui.tooltipFahrwege: The lanes inside the lot and how they connect.
ui.tooltipFehlendReparieren: Rebuilds the lot with your saved default surface and plants in place of the missing ones. Shape and all other settings stay.
ui.tooltipFensterHeim: Puts the window back where it started - the way out if you pushed it off the screen.
ui.tooltipFlaecheDeko: Chooses which decoration surface is laid.
ui.tooltipFlaecheDekoAn: Lays the decoration surface. Off leaves the ground untouched.
ui.tooltipFlaecheStrasse: Chooses which road surface is laid.
ui.tooltipFlaecheStrasseAn: Lays the road surface. Off leaves the ground untouched.
ui.tooltipFlaechen: Which ground is laid, and the markings on it.
ui.tooltipFussweg: The way in on foot. Disabled and electric bays move here.
ui.tooltipGasse: Same placement as an entrance, but built as an invisible alley. The street outside gets a real junction, so its kerb opens up. It costs a few zoning cells there.
ui.tooltipGasseAus: An alley that only leads OUT: from the lot onto the street. Narrower than the two-way alley, and the kerb opens up just the same.
ui.tooltipGasseEin: An alley that only leads IN: from the street into the lot. Narrower than the two-way alley, and the kerb opens up just the same.
ui.tooltipGebuehr: What drivers pay here. In CS2 a fee does not earn you money per lot - it steers drivers to other lots.
ui.tooltipGebuehrHaken: Turns the fee off and back on. The amount you set is kept.
ui.tooltipGebuehrRegler: Drag to set what drivers pay here. It steers them between lots rather than earning you money.
ui.tooltipGruen: Where grass goes instead of paving.
ui.tooltipGruenstreifentiefe: Widens the median. Costs a row of bays.
ui.tooltipHinspringen: Select this lot and move the camera to it.
ui.tooltipKappen: Caps each row with grass. Off packs in more cars.
ui.tooltipLeistung: Records one line per second and one for every frame over 50 ms, broken down by what the mod was doing. Frames that are not ours show up as such.
ui.tooltipLetzteZurueck: Takes back the mark you just set.
ui.tooltipListe: Every lot you built: figures, fee and a jump to it.
ui.tooltipListeArbeit.one: 1 parking lot needs a sync or repair - open the list.
ui.tooltipListeArbeit.other: {n} parking lots need a sync or repair - open the list.
ui.tooltipLotBericht: Writes one file about THIS parking lot - what it was built from and what the mod did. Send it along if something here looks wrong.
ui.tooltipMeldeLot: Then click a lot out in the world; right-click cancels.
ui.tooltipMelden: Marks the odd spots and writes them up for me.
ui.tooltipMeldungAbsturz: Packs everything about the last crash into one file: what the mod did last, the game's crash dump read out, and the logs of that run.
ui.tooltipMeldungOrdner: Opens the folder holding the files, ready to attach.
ui.tooltipMeldungVorschau: Reports what the preview shows right now - nothing has to be built yet.
ui.tooltipMittelgruen: Slips a strip of grass between two back-to-back rows.
ui.tooltipOrtSpringen: Select this place and move the camera to it.
ui.tooltipQuerstrassenbreite: Widens the cross roads between the rows.
ui.tooltipRandabstand: Increases the setback from the outline. Tidier, costs spaces.
ui.tooltipRandstrassen: Off uses the full site for rows. Roads serving edge zoning remain.
ui.tooltipReihenwinkel: Sets the row angle for the whole lot.
ui.tooltipReset: Brings every value back to your defaults.
ui.tooltipRueckgaengig: Takes back the last completed step · Ctrl+Z
ui.tooltipStellenMarkieren: Turns the left mouse button into a marker pen. Click every spot that looks wrong.
ui.tooltipStil: Switches the window between a narrow upright column at the left and a wide bar above the toolbar. Same settings either way.
ui.tooltipSync: Updates this parking lot to the current version. Its shape and settings remain.
ui.tooltipSyncAlle: Updates all listed parking lots one after another. Shapes and settings remain.
ui.tooltipSyncAuto: Same switch as in the mod settings. Updates existing parking lots one at a time after loading.
ui.tooltipSyncHinweis: Opens the parking lot list, where you can update one lot or all of them.
ui.tooltipTrennungFertig: Takes the cuts you drew as the sub-areas and starts picking reference lines. Without a cut the whole outline stays one area.
ui.tooltipUmbenennenListe: Click the name to rename this lot.
ui.tooltipVerbindungAlle: Adds a cross road after this many bays. Shorter walks.
ui.tooltipVorflaeche: Carries the road surface across the pavement to the asphalt.
ui.tooltipWaiseReparieren: Reconnects the lot to the mod. Shape, markings and roads stay exactly as they are.
ui.tooltipWaisenAuto: Same switch as in the mod settings. When on, orphaned lots are reconnected and lots with missing assets are repaired after loading, one at a time.
ui.tooltipWiederherstellen: Puts back the step you just undid · Ctrl+Y
ui.tooltipWinkel: Turns the rows away from the edge. Only listened to with Fixed.
ui.tooltipWinkelFest: Takes the angle from the slider below, measured from the edge.
ui.tooltipWinkelNormal: Rows along the line you picked.
ui.tooltipWinkelQuer: Rows at a right angle to the reference line.
ui.tooltipZoningAussentiefe: How deep the next band you click becomes, in 8 m tiles.
ui.tooltipZoningFlaeche: Picks the surface painted under the building parcels.
ui.tooltipZoningGesperrt: Draw and close an outline first — the parcels sit inside the parking lot.
ui.tooltipZoningLinie: Pick one line of your outline; the parcels follow it instead of the longest edge.
ui.tooltipZoningLinieAbbrechen: Stops picking. The outline stays as it is.
ui.tooltipZoningReiter: Places building parcels inside the parking lot.
ui.tooltipZoningSeiten: Two jobs, one tool - whatever is closer to the cursor wins. On a zoning road: click the side you mean to turn its zoning on or off. On a line of the outline: click to turn that stretch into edge zoning - the perimeter road there becomes a zoning road and houses grow outward. Right click or Esc leaves the mode.
ui.tooltipZoningSeitenGesperrt: Only works on built roads. Build the parking lot first - the switch changes a flag on a real road, and in the preview there is none yet.
ui.tooltipZoningSetzen: Turns the left mouse button over to the parcels. The outline stays as it is.
ui.tooltipZoningWinkel: Same four modes as the parking rows, with their own values — the parcels do not have to line up with the bays.
ui.tooltipZufahrt: Cars come in and go out here.
ui.tooltipZuschnitt: Shape and direction of the bay rows.
ui.vegetation.100MaximumPlantingDensityW: 100%: maximum planting density with spacing between plants
ui.vegetation.chooseASetOrIndividual: Choose a set or individual plants.
ui.vegetation.onTreesKeepTheirAge: On: trees keep their age and stop growing. Off: CS2 ages them like trees in nature.
ui.vegetation.plantVegetationOnDecoratio: Plant vegetation on the decoration surface
ui.vegetation.saveTheCurrentSelectionAs: Save the current selection as your own set under this name
ui.vegetation.someSelectedAssetsAreMissi: Some selected assets are missing and cannot be planted.
ui.vegetation.vegetationIsOffTheSwitch: Vegetation is off - the switch in the panel decides whether anything is planted.
ui.waiseErklaerung: This save was stored while Parking Lot Tool was off or missing, so the lot lost its link to the mod.
ui.waiseNichtReparierbar: Its parts cannot be matched to it without doubt, so it is not repaired.
ui.zoningFlaecheHinweis: The ground under the parcels only — the zoning road stays a road surface like all the others. Off lays no surface under the parcels.
ui.zoningHinweis: Drag a rectangle inside the closed outline. It snaps to whole 8 m parcels, up to the largest size set in the mod settings. Drag a patch to move it, right-click to delete it. What you drag are the parcels only — the zoning road is added around them.
ui.zoningSeiteHinweis: The zoning road runs around what you drew. Every side of it can carry extra parcels outside, each with its own depth. The parking lot keeps that room free — no aisle, no cross road, no bays.
ui.zoningTiefeKlick: Pick a depth, then turn on “Toggle road sides” and click the OUTER side of a zoning road. Clicking the same side again removes the band.
undo.polygonGeoeffnetPunktEntfernt: polygon reopened and last point removed
versorgungsanschluss.utilitiesConnectedT: Utilities connected. The missing-utility warning icon may stay visible for a while.
vorschaufehler.umrissUngueltig: No preview: the outline crosses or folds back on itself. Move a corner so it encloses an area.
vorschaufehler.unbekannt: No preview: this shape could not be calculated. Move a corner slightly; if it keeps failing, please send a preview report via “Report a problem”.
vorschaufehler.zeitgrenze: No preview: the surfaces of this shape take too long to calculate. Please send a preview report via “Report a problem”.
vorschaufehler.zuKlein: No preview: no parking row fits into this shape. Make the shape larger or wider.
vorschaufehler.zuKleinRandstrassen: No preview: no parking row fits into this shape. Make the shape larger, or switch off the perimeter roads.
vorschaufehler.zufahrt: No preview: an entrance no longer fits on its edge. Move or remove the entrance.
zoning.closeTheOutlineFirstThenPlace: Close the outline first, then place zoning patches.
zoning.flaechenGeloescht.one: {n} zoning patch deleted: no longer fully inside.
zoning.flaechenGeloescht.other: {n} zoning patches deleted: no longer fully inside.
zoning.noRoomForAParcelHere: No room for a parcel here.
zoning.nowClickALineOfThe: Now click a line of the outline.
zoning.thePatchKeepsItsOldAngle: The patch keeps its old angle: rotated it would not fit inside.
zoning.zoningDragARectangleRightClick: Zoning: drag a rectangle. Right-click a patch to delete it.
zoning.zugGekappt: {zug}  —  that is the limit: CS2 builds at most {maxBreite} by {maxTiefe} parcels
zoningRoadEdit.edgeZoningOnThisLineClick: Edge zoning on this line — click removes it
zoningRoadEdit.edgeZoningRoadItAlwaysZon: Edge-zoning road — it always zones outwards, there is no side to choose here.
zoningRoadEdit.nearestZoningRoadIsMAway: Nearest zoning road is {bester} m away — move closer.
zoningRoadEdit.noPointUnderTheCursorPoin: No point under the cursor — point at the ground.
zoningRoadEdit.noRoomAZoningPatchSits: No room: a zoning patch sits here and cannot move aside
zoningRoadEdit.noZoningRoadPlannedDragAn: No zoning road planned — drag an area first.
zoningRoadEdit.outlineEdgeClickTurnsItIn: Outline edge — click turns it into edge zoning
zoningRoadEdit.outsideTilesDeepTheParkin: Outside {tiefe} tiles deep — the parking lot keeps that room free.
zoningRoadEdit.seiteLinksAn: left side: zoning ON — click turns it off
zoningRoadEdit.seiteLinksAus: left side: zoning OFF — click turns it on
zoningRoadEdit.seiteRechtsAn: right side: zoning ON — click turns it off
zoningRoadEdit.seiteRechtsAus: right side: zoning OFF — click turns it on
